tei:div.tei:p: g.yang glud ngar mi chang bu dang*// sbang ma sha shun ram pa rnams// gyo chag gam ni lder chag nang*// bzhag la khrus chu chang skyur ram// zho lad 'o rul bran la bzhag /khyim la gtor rgyu'i 'o dkar dang*// thun gtor rgyu yi rdo phye bsags// dang po yi dam gtor ma bsham// rang gi yi dam lha gzhung gyer/ hūm̐/ rang nyid yi dam gnas 'gyur te// dran rdzogs khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil// sku mdog ljang la dmar ba'i mdangs// g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar phyar// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub me 'bar mdzad// khro bo'i chas kun yongs su rdzogs// zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs dgra bgegs mnan// thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ ljang mthar// sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba las// 'od zer ljang gu phyogs bcur 'phros// 'og min gnas nas bdud rtsi 'khyil// rang 'dra dpag med spyan drangs te// bdag dang nas 'bru rnams la thim// thun rdo re dang nas 'bru re// rang 'dra'i bdud rtsi 'khyil pa re// me 'bar tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur// oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces stong phrag tsam zhig bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags de phreng skor gcig gnyis kyis// 'o dkar dang ni thun sngags bzhag /oṃ a mṛ te ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shap+da'i bar/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs// bgegs rigs 'dul ba'i gnyen por bskos// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i mthu stobs kyis// bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang*// khang khyim 'di la 'khri ba yi// ltog 'gong dbul sri bse rag rnams// rang gzugs yas stags 'di la khug

/bse rag rgyal po gzhon nu pa// ltog 'gong dbul sri mang pos bskor// god ka thams cad khyod las byung*// dbul 'dre dbul sri khyod las byung*// lo nyes thog nyes khyod las byung*// mi la na tsha khyod las byung*// nor la god ka khyod las byung*// tshe la bar chad khyod las byung*// dme 'dre thams cad khyod las byung*// za kha 'thung kha khyod kyis 'phrog /bu tsha'i bla ni khyod kyis brkus// bza' mi'i 'thab 'dre khyod kyis byas// de phyir gnod byed 'khor dang bcas// gzugs brnyan 'di la thim par gyur// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ /ces gnod byed thams cad gzugs brnyan la sib sib thim par bsgom/ de nas g.yang glud ngar mi bran/ hūm̐/ nga ni khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil// ljang nag rgya gram sdigs mdzub mdzad// khro bo'i chas kun sku la rdzogs// nyon cig bse rag 'gong po'i tshogs// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di nyid la// tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas// rku 'phrog rlom pa'i lan chags bdag /thams cad 'dir 'dus glud gtor longs// gzugs mdzes 'byams klas 'jigs bral dang*// rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// rang rang yid mthun snod nang du// glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas// khyed rnams mgu zhing tshim gyur cig /bse rag rgyal po gzhon nu pa// bu chung gzugs la g.yu rna can// sba dmar gri chung sked la bcug /chibs su ri bong kha sho chibs// sreg pa bdun ni klad na lding*// khyi gu ri'u tshe shis dang sgis// chung gsum bse rag mang pos bskor// yod la mi dga' med la dga'// gang la mi dga' stong la dga'// brgyag la mi dga' ltog la dga'// phyug la mi dga' dbul la dga'// blo nyes tshong nyes gtong ba'i bdag /khyod la glud dang gtor ma sbyin// yon bdag 'di la ma gnod cig /bse rag rgyal po nag po ni// mi rgan nag po chen po zhig

/gos su kho shog skam po gyon// kha na rus pa snum med mur// kha nas sdug glu mug glu len// sprul pa byi la byis pa 'gyed// mchig gi steng nas phye la rku// dkar thog rlom zhing skyur thog bcom// khyod la lan chags glud gtor sbyin// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du song*// god 'dre mi nag phag la zhon// grod pa'i zhwa la rgyu mas brgyan// lag na bsha' gri dmar po khur// nor bdud kham pa khyi mgo sogs// god 'dre gri bo 'gong pos bskor// khyod la glud dang gtor ma sbyin// 'di ru ma gnod gzhan du song*// gzhan yang 'gong po dam sri dang*// 'dre mo gri bo gri mo dang*// sgab 'dre ltog 'gong dbul sri rnams// ngar mi ting lo chang bu dang*// sha shun sbang skam chang skyur dang*// zho lad ram pa la sogs pa'i// rang rang mthun rdzas 'di khyer la// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// yon bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la// ma nye ma 'khor ma gnod par// dpag tshad mang po'i pha rol du// da lta nyid du 'gro bar gyis// oṃ nṛ tri shan tri ka tri i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun gyis bsngo/ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha gats+tsha/ zhes sbra khyim mi mthong sar bskyal bcug go /de nas sngags pas thun bzung la/ hūm̐/ nga ni khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil// rang 'dra'i khro chung ser ltar 'bebs// bskal pa'i me dpung 'tshubs shing 'bar// gang dag 'gro bar mi byed pa'i// bse rag ltog 'gong rdul du rlog /oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod cing sbra khyim nor slas thams cad du thun gtor/ de nas 'o dkar shug los gtor cing*/ hūm̐/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i byin rlabs las// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// phug gi lha la khrus gsol lo// phug lha pha mtshun g.yang rgan la// grib kyis phog pa dag gyur cig

/sbra dang khyim la khrus gsol lo// rtsog 'dre dme rmug dag gyur cig /mi dang nor la khrus gsol lo// bse rag god 'dre sangs gyur cig /oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yaṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ laṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang rnam 'joms sogs 'don cing sbra khyim nor slas thams cad la gtor/
